text: The service SHALL expire every issued access token after a fixed lifetime and reject expired tokens on every protected endpoint.
When a request presents an access token issued more than 3600 seconds ago, respond with HTTP 401.
source_ref: spec.md › ADDED › Requirement: Token expiry › Scenario: A token past its lifetime is used › THEN[1]

text: When a request presents an access token issued more than 3600 seconds ago, include an error code of `token_expired`.
source_ref: spec.md › ADDED › Requirement: Token expiry › Scenario: A token past its lifetime is used › AND[2]

text: When a request presents a token issued within the last 3600 seconds, process the request normally.
source_ref: spec.md › ADDED › Requirement: Token expiry › Scenario: A fresh token is used › THEN[1]

text: The service SHALL issue an access token on a successful password grant, and the response SHALL now also include a `refresh_token`.
When valid credentials are posted to `/oauth/token`, return an `access_token` and a `refresh_token`.
source_ref: spec.md › MODIFIED › Requirement: Token issuance › Scenario: Successful password grant › THEN[1]

text: The service previously accepted a long-lived static API key in the `X-API-Key` header. This is removed.
source_ref: spec.md › REMOVED › Requirement: Static API keys
